notes.basics: Petersburg is an independent city in Virginia. Its tax year starts on 1 January, so values are as of 2026-01-01.
notes.files: Petersburg sends two files: a parcel map, and one CAMA table that holds both property details and each parcel's latest sale.
notes.stitch: The map's PAR_ID and the CAMA table's Parcel are the same IDs, so they match as they are. The CAMA table has one row per parcel, with each parcel's latest sale. A few map parcels are drawn as several polygons; they are merged into one shape.
notes.columns: Petersburg's columns are matched to OpenAVMKit's standard fields. Land area comes in acres and is converted to square feet.
notes.sales_basics: Petersburg marks valid sales with the codes Q, 00 and L. L also means the land was vacant when sold.

files.name: petersburg-dbo-cama-fix.parquet
files.description: Property details and each parcel's latest sale, one row per parcel.
